place.title: Place
place.description: The city or neighborhood to find events around.

daysAhead.title: Days ahead
daysAhead.description: How many days ahead to look, starting today (or the start date).

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Optional first day of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to now.

eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.description: Which kinds of events to keep.

sources.title: Built-in sources
sources.description: Built-in sources to scout, one agent each, in parallel. Leave empty for all. The venue presets cover Berkeley and Oakland; 'web' searches the open web for any place.

customSources.title: Your own listing pages
customSources.description: Extra public listing pages, each scouted by its own agent: objects with name, url, and optionally kind (official_feed, venue_site, listing, web) and useProxy.

maxEventsPerSource.title: Max events per source
maxEventsPerSource.description: Each source stops after saving this many events, soonest first.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Your Anthropic API key. The agent runs on Claude; usage is billed to this key.
